question: Which of the following is a hydrate of sodium carbonate containing ten molecules of water of crystallisation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Washing Powder.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Washing powder**__

 __
 
• **Na2CO3.10H2O** is the chemical formula for washing soda.
 
• It is **decahydrate sodium carbonate**. 
 
• It has** ten molecules of water.**
 
 
 
• **Water of crystallisation**__
 __
 
• The quantity of water molecules that chemically mix in a specific molecular ratio with the relevant salt in the crystalline state is known as the water of crystallisation.
 
• The crystals' geometrical pattern and colour are a result of this water.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
